title: 第15章 恐怖的吞噬之力第16章 阴阳学宫上门挑衅
slug: 我装了三年废物出手人间无敌
content_zh:
青州，功法武技等级分为天、地、玄、黄四个等级，每个等级又分上中下三品。
楚云发现石碑上记载的六大绝技，不是没有等级，就是天级武技。
“楚云，别的武技可以不用理会，但是这个天雷掌你无论如何，也要想办法学会。”
就在这时，镜灵的声音在楚云的脑海中响起。
“为何？”
楚云问道。
镜灵道：“你现在已经是地武境八重，随时有机会冲击天武境，但你可能不知道，冲击天武境会遇到天劫，引下天雷。”
“到时候要是你没有应对的武技，很容易受伤，而且在冲击天武境的时候，你坚持的时间越长，等进入天武境后，你的肉身会比同级更强，甚至还有可能锻造出雷体。”
听到这话，楚云目光一凝，道：“行，我尽量想办法学会。”
六大绝技只有北灵学院院长才会，要想修炼，必须依靠青铜古镜进行窥探。
“楚长老，这六大绝技没什么好看的，虽然看起来威力强大，但是以我们的身份，估计是接触不到。”
见楚云站在石碑前半天不动，马脸老者开口说道。
楚云道：“我只是随便看看，对了，我住的地方在哪里，带我去。”
“行，你跟我来。”
就在这时，他发现叶灵儿居然还跟着他。
当下怒道：“你还跟着为师干什么，不是让你去关禁闭吗？”
叶灵儿看着楚云，似乎有话想跟他说。
但是见马脸老者发怒，她只能低声道：“是。”
说完，便转身离开。
“楚长老，走。”

待到叶灵儿离开，马脸老者面带微笑，带着楚云朝着学院深处走去。
很快，两人便来到一处叫做“长老阁”
的地方。
“这里就是我们外院长老住的地方了，你可以随便选一间房居住。”
“好。”
听到这话，楚云便朝着阁楼上走去。
马脸老者见状，并没有跟上去，而是转身离开。
楚云来到阁楼上，找到一间比较隐蔽的房间，便走了进去。
进入房间后，楚云立刻盘坐在床榻上，然后取出青铜古镜。
随着能量灌入，只见青铜古镜里面出现一幅画面。
正是北灵学院的全景。
楚云动用意念，开始在北灵学院里面扫视。
随着不断扫视，楚云发现北灵学院不但有提升修为的地方，还有炼丹炼器的地方。
很快，他的目光停留在了学院深处，一座阁楼上。
content_en:
In Qingzhou, the levels of martial arts and martial arts are divided into four levels: Heaven, Earth, Xuan, and Huang, and each level is divided into three levels: upper, middle, and lower.
Chu Yun discovered that the six unique skills recorded on the stone tablet were either without levels or were heaven-level martial arts.
"Chu Yun, you can ignore other martial arts, but you must find a way to learn this Thunder Palm no matter what."
At this moment, Jing Ling's voice sounded in Chu Yun's mind.
"Why?"
Chu Yun asked.
Jing Ling said: "You are now at the eighth level of the Earth Martial Realm, and you have the opportunity to attack the Tian Martial Realm at any time, but you may not know that if you attack the Tian Martial Realm, you will encounter a catastrophe and cause thunder."
"If you don't have the martial arts to deal with it, you will be easily injured. Moreover, the longer you hold on when you hit the Tianwu Realm, your physical body will be stronger than the same level after you enter the Tianwu Realm, and you may even be able to forge a thunder body."
Upon hearing this, Chu Yun's eyes narrowed and he said, "Okay, I'll try my best to learn how to do it."
Only the dean of Beiling Academy can master the six special skills. If you want to practice them, you must rely on the ancient bronze mirror for spying.
"Elder Chu, there's nothing interesting about these six stunts. Although they look powerful, given our status, we probably can't access them."
Seeing Chu Yun standing in front of the stone tablet without moving for a long time, the horse-faced old man spoke.
Chu Yun said: "I just took a look. By the way, where is the place where I live? Take me there."
"Okay, come with me."
At this moment, he discovered that Ye Ling'er was still following him.
Then he said angrily: "Why are you still following me? Didn't I ask you to be put in solitary confinement?"
Ye Ling'er looked at Chu Yun, as if she wanted to tell him something.
But seeing the horse-faced old man angry, she could only whisper: "Yes."
After saying that, he turned around and left.
"Elder Chu, let's go."
When Ye Ling'er left, the horse-faced old man walked towards the depths of the college with Chu Yun with a smile.
Soon, the two of them came to a place called "Elder Pavilion"
place.
"This is where our foreign dean lives. You can choose any room to live in."
"Okay."
Upon hearing this, Chu Yun walked towards the attic.
When the horse-faced old man saw this, he did not follow him, but turned around and left.
Chu Yun came to the attic, found a relatively hidden room, and walked in.
After entering the room, Chu Yun immediately sat cross-legged on the bed, and then took out the ancient bronze mirror.
As the energy poured in, a picture appeared in the ancient bronze mirror.
It is the panoramic view of Beiling College.
Chu Yun used his mind and began to scan around Beiling Academy.
As he kept scanning, Chu Yun discovered that Beiling Academy not only had a place to improve his cultivation, but also a place to refine alchemy and weapons.
Soon, his eyes rested on an attic deep in the academy.
